text: Add only the shapes requested by the current task. Existing objects are labeled with letters. Determine their positions and sizes from the image. Do not erase or alter existing objects. Canvas coordinates are integers 0 through 80 on each axis; x increases rightward, y downward. One coordinate unit is 8 pixels. One grid unit of alignment/contour error is allowed, size ratios allow 10% relative error. Separation and containment require at least two units of clearance. Colors: black, red, green, blue, orange, purple. Available tools: pen. Actions: tool, color, move, down, up, undo, finish. Tool/color changes require the pen up. Down begins a shape at the current tip. Up commits it. Undo cancels an active stroke, otherwise removes the most recently completed new shape. Finish submits even if incomplete. Invalid actions waste one operation. All seven actions remain available. Every move while down permanently adds a straight ink segment. Each requested shape must be one continuous stroke. Close circles and rectangles to within one coordinate unit. Return exactly one JSON object, without markdown or explanation. Schemas: {"action":"tool","tool":"circle"}, {"action":"color","color":"red"}, {"action":"move","x":10,"y":20}, or {"action":"down"}, {"action":"up"}, {"action":"undo"}, {"action":"finish"}. No additional keys.
